sentences.en: Read the blueprint before you cut anything.
sentences.target: مخکې له دې چې څه پرې کړئ، نقشه ولولئ.

sentences.en: Set the studs sixteen inches apart.
sentences.target: سټډونه شپاړس انچه له یو بل څخه لرې ولګوئ.

sentences.en: Make sure the wall is plumb.
sentences.target: ډاډ ترلاسه کړئ چې دېوال عمودي دی.

sentences.en: This board is too short; cut another one.
sentences.target: دا تخته ډېره لنډه ده؛ بله پرې کړه.

sentences.en: Check the level one more time.
The inspector comes tomorrow at two.
Good work today; see you in the morning.
sentences.target: نن ښه کار وشو؛ سبا سهار به سره ووینو.
